rules.name: Cross-sectional24h momentum
rules.rule: AtUTCcandle-open hours divisibleby4, compute24hreturn acrossall availablealts, demean crosssectionmedian; one largestabsresidual, alphabeticaltie; longresidual>=.02 andclose>EMA50>EMA200,shortmirror<=-.02; winnerchosenbeforefilters

rules.name: BTC residualfade
rules.rule: AtUTC4hourdecision, alt24hreturn minusBTC24hreturn; one maxabsresidual,tiealphabetical; requireabsBTC6hreturn<.02;long residual<=-.03 andRSI14<35 andclose>open;short residual>=.03 andRSI14>65 andclose<open; choosewinnerbeforefilters
